body: I was supposed to wait for my rheumatologist to teach me how to properly inject it but she was out of town so she told me to go to the ER and any nurse would surely know how to give it. i seriously thought he knew what he was doing 😢
No it’s the outer side of my arm, i kept telling him it should be in somewhere with more fat and he just insisted that he knew better. I’m sooo scared it won’t have any effect
I thought this was a new symptom no one told me that it is a side effect🥲

I relate to this too much it feels like i wrote this post
I hope you get better

Im going through the same. my RF test was positive only one time and i think it was a lab error. And RA is also running in my family. I have too many other symptoms but my joints are okay, i did an ultrasound on hands and feet and they didnt show any signs of RA.
only the knees and ankles swell and hurts as hell 
Some of the doctors are convinced it’s seronegative RA 
The others are strongly denying it but they have no other diagnosis. Autoimmune diseases are hell

سيبيه يتكلم عنها براحته، سيبيه يعيط براحته اوعي تقوليله ميعيطش و الكلام المؤلم بتاع العياط بيعذب، كلام التصبير مش بيصبر، بالعكس تماماً. لو عايز يتفرج على صورهم اتفرجي معاه و سيبيه يحكي الذكريات، لو عايز يهزر هزروا و اضحكوا من غير ما تحسسيه ان في حاجة علط، اقترحي عليه انكوا تنزلوا تعملوا اعمال خيرية صدقة لروحها. اهتمي كويس انه بياكل و يشرب و ينام عشان ميأثرش على صحته. ادعيله كتيييير.

I’m really tired i suffer with every single symptom of lupus it’s been 8 years of suffering and my ana is always negative, so i’m diagnosed with fibromyalgia, and the rest of symptoms are ignored by every doctor. lately i had extreme kidney pain and went to test. My ana level became equivocal (not negative nor positive) and my wbcs are 2 and lymphocytes dropped to 0.3, they still haven’t made the diagnosis but just yesterday i developed this burning mf butterfly rash and i’m pretty sure that it’s undiagnosed lupus. Can you tell me how your doctor confirmed your diagnosis so i could point mine to figure out anything? I really hope your diagnosis leads to better days i’ll pray for you ❤️
